findings.title: Stale intermediate origin still certifies a multi-hop source chain
reproduction: Create reviewed primary ROOT, derived repost0 quoting primary, and leaf quoting repost0; positive summary([leaf]) reports 1 confirmed root.
Delete repost0 local file and run RefreshLocalSnapshots; repost0 Evidence metadata becomes STALE.
Recompute summary([leaf]) while primary and leaf remain readable.
findings.cause: originRoot traverses relation IDs but does not validate intermediate Evidence visibility/currentness or reviewed basis. Summary only checks starting leaf and final root.
findings.minimum_fix: Validate every traversed Evidence and its exact reviewed basis before certifying a current source chain; retain historical graph metadata. Apply shared check to origin registration and support summary.

passed_checks: Real Windows registered root rename and replacement junction denied; child junction denied; authorized root positive content preserved.
Modify/delete/revoke/move variants: same-key search no old body; old materialization rejected; new context with old Task input rejected; new clean context materializes without stale body.
Direct content rejects before and after Refresh; metadata retained as STALE or REVOKED.
One original plus four direct reposts plus independent measured experiment yields 2; 20 SIMULATED add no observed support; unreviewed exact-byte copy stays UNKNOWN.
Changing the actual primary origin drops observed support to 1 despite exact bytes remaining at unknown copy.
Unicode Chinese and ASCII hit locators remain line 2 and 3 after preceding dotted I and emoji; forced FTS failure yields actual bounded-scan result.
Legacy migration sets empty root identity registration revoked=1 and revision increments.
Same idempotency key cannot replay project A source in project B; revoking the principal denies cached search and direct content with 401.
